description: This file defines the HiringManagerUserRole class, which extends AbstractUserRole and includes methods to retrieve accessible IDs for various entities related to recruitment, such as vacancies, candidates, interviews, and attachments, specifically tailored for hiring managers within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: HiringManagerUserRole
classes.description: A class that manages access permissions for hiring managers in the recruitment module, providing methods to retrieve IDs of entities they have access to based on their employee number and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs for a given entity type that the user has access to, based on the entity's class.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of vacancies accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of vacancy attachments accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of candidates accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of interviews accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of interview attachments accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of candidate histories accessible to the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of candidate action histories accessible to the user.
